info.name: KhatiUp API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the KhatiUp application.

## Setup
1. Register → Verify OTP → Copy `access_token`
2. Set `{{access_token}}` variable or paste it in the Bearer Token
3. For Socket.IO: Use the **Socket.IO Requests** section in Postman

## Variables
- `base_url`: http://localhost:3000
- `access_token`: JWT token from login/verify-otp
- `chatId`: MongoDB ObjectId of a chat
- `messageId`: MongoDB ObjectId of a message
- `userId`: MongoDB ObjectId of a target user

item.name: Group
item.description:
Group chat CRUD operations (all require Bearer token).

Socket notifications are sent automatically:
- `group-created` → all members
- `group-updated` → all participants
- `group-deleted` → all participants

request.description:
Creates a new group chat. The authenticated user becomes the creator and admin.

**Socket notification:** `group-created` sent to all members.

**Auto-saves `chatId` on success.**

Update group name, description, or profile image. Only admins.

**Socket notification:** `group-updated` sent to all participants.

Deactivates the group and removes the chat. Only the group creator.

**Socket notification:** `group-deleted` sent to all participants.

item.name: Members
item.description:
Group member management (all require Bearer token).

Socket notifications are sent automatically:
- `member-added` → all participants (including new member)
- `member-removed` → all previous participants (including removed member)

request.description:
Adds a user to the group chat. Only admins.

**Socket notification:** `member-added` sent to all participants.

Removes a user from the group. Admins can remove anyone; non-admins can only remove themselves (leave).

**Socket notification:** `member-removed` sent to all previous participants.

item.name: Chats
item.description: Chat list and detail (all require Bearer token)

request.description:
Returns all chats (direct & group) for the authenticated user.

Response includes:
- **Direct chats:** populated participant name, profile_photo, mobile_number
- **Group chats:** populated group name, profileImage, description, admins
Returns a single chat with fully populated participants and group info.

item.name: Socket.IO Events
item.description:
## ⚡ Socket.IO Real-Time Events

Postman supports Socket.IO natively! To test these events:

### How to Connect
1. In Postman, click **New → Socket.IO Request**
2. Set URL to: `http://localhost:3000`
3. Under **Settings**, set the **Handshake Path** to `/socket.io`
4. Under **Auth** (Headers tab), add:
   - **Key:** `auth` → `{ "token": "<your_access_token>" }`
   - Or add header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
5. Click **Connect**

---

### Client → Server Events

After connecting, use the **Message** tab to emit these events:

| Event Name | Payload |
|---|---|
| `send-message` | See 'Send Message' request below |
| `edit-message` | See 'Edit Message' request below |
| `delete-message` | See 'Delete Message' request below |
| `get-messages` | See 'Get Messages' request below |
| `typing` | See 'Typing' request below |

### Server → Client Events (Listen for these)

| Event | Triggered By |
|---|---|
| `receive-message` | Someone sent a message in your chat |
| `message-edited` | A message was edited |
| `message-deleted` | A message was soft-deleted |
| `user-typing` | Someone is typing |
| `group-created` | You were added to a new group (REST API) |
| `group-updated` | Group details changed (REST API) |
| `group-deleted` | A group was deleted (REST API) |
| `member-added` | New member added to group (REST API) |
| `member-removed` | Member removed from group (REST API) |

request.description:
## Socket.IO Event: `send-message`

**This is NOT a REST endpoint.** Use Postman's Socket.IO request to emit this event.

### Payload (existing chat)
```json
{
  "chatId": "<chatId>",
  "content": "Hello!",
  "messageType": "text",
  "attachmentUrl": null,
  "replyTo": null
}
```

### Payload (new direct chat — auto-creates)
```json
{
  "receiverId": "<userId>",
  "content": "Hey!",
  "messageType": "text"
}
```

### Server Response
Emits `receive-message` to all participants:
```json
{
  "message": { ... },
  "chatId": "<chatId>"
}
```

### Notes
- `senderId` is extracted from JWT — never send it
- `messageType`: text, image, video, audio, file, location, system
- For replies, set `replyTo` to the original message's `_id`

## Socket.IO Event: `edit-message`

### Payload
```json
{
  "messageId": "<messageId>",
  "chatId": "<chatId>",
  "newContent": "Updated text"
}
```

### Server Response
Emits `message-edited` to all participants:
```json
{
  "messageId": "<messageId>",
  "chatId": "<chatId>",
  "newContent": "Updated text",
  "editedAt": "2026-06-28T..."
}
```

### Notes
- Only the sender can edit their own messages
- Sets `isEdited: true` and `editedAt` on the message

## Socket.IO Event: `delete-message`

### Payload
```json
{
  "messageId": "<messageId>",
  "chatId": "<chatId>"
}
```

### Server Response
Emits `message-deleted` to all participants:
```json
{
  "messageId": "<messageId>",
  "chatId": "<chatId>",
  "deletedAt": "2026-06-28T..."
}
```

### Notes
- Soft delete — message stays in DB with `isDeleted: true`
- Content is cleared to empty string

## Socket.IO Event: `get-messages`

### Payload
```json
{
  "chatId": "<chatId>",
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 50
}
```

### Ack Callback Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "messages": [...],
    "pagination": {
      "page": 1,
      "limit": 50,
      "total": 120,
      "pages": 3
    }
  }
}
```

### Notes
- Uses Socket.IO acknowledgement (callback), not a separate emit
- Messages are sorted newest-first
- Sender info and reply-to are populated

## Socket.IO Event: `typing`

### Payload (Direct chat)
```json
{
  "receiverId": "<userId>"
}
```

### Payload (Group chat)
```json
{
  "chatId": "<chatId>"
}
```

### Server Response
Emits `user-typing` to the receiver(s):
```json
{
  "senderId": "<userId>",
  "chatId": "<chatId>"
}
```

### Notes
- For direct chats: only the receiver gets the event
- For group chats: all participants except the sender get the event
